activate_strength.description: Automates the overworld activation of the STRENGTH move from the party menu by navigating to the second party member (ROCKY/GEODUDE), selecting STRENGTH, and completely closing all menus back to the overworld.

autopress_buttons.description: If true, the generated sequence of buttons will be pressed automatically.

activate_strength.python_script:
import json

# Generate the button sequence to activate Strength and exit all menus
button_sequence = [
    "Start", "sleep 1000",
    "Down", "sleep 500",
    "A", "sleep 1000",
    "Down", "sleep 500",
    "A", "sleep 1000",
    "A", "sleep 1500",
    "A", "sleep 1500",
    "B", "sleep 500",
    "B", "sleep 500",
    "B"
]

print(json.dumps(button_sequence))

history.commit_message: Define activate_strength tool to automate the STRENGTH overworld activation from the party menu.
Added B button presses at the end of the Strength activation sequence to completely close all menus and return cleanly to the overworld.
